title: Constructor injection of io.opentelemetry.api.metrics.Meter in a @GrpcService-annotated class makes tests fail
body:
### Describe the bug

When trying to use OpenTelemetry metrics within a @GrpcService-annotated class via constructor injection of `io.opentelemetry.api.metrics.Meter` like this:

```java
@GrpcService
public class HelloGrpcService implements HelloGrpc {
    private final LongCounter counter;

    public HelloGrpcService(Meter meter) {
        counter = meter.counterBuilder("hello-metrics")
                .setDescription("hello-metrics")
                .setUnit("invocations")
                .build();
    }

    @Override
    public Uni<HelloReply> sayHello(HelloRequest request) {
        counter.add(1);

        return Uni.createFrom().item("Hello " + request.getName() + "!")
                .map(msg -> HelloReply.newBuilder().setMessage(msg).build());
    }
}
```
leads to exception when running tests: `java.lang.IllegalStateException: GlobalOpenTelemetry.set has already been called. GlobalOpenTelemetry.set must be called only once before any calls to GlobalOpenTelemetry.get. If you are using the OpenTelemetrySdk, use OpenTelemetrySdkBuilder.buildAndRegisterGlobal instead. Previous invocation set to cause of this exception.`

Running application in Dev mode is not affected.
Switching from constructor injection of the Meter class to field injection makes tests pass successfully.

### Expected behavior

Successful tests execution.

### Actual behavior

Running test fails with error.

1. Clone https://github.com/Ultranium/quarkus-opentelemetry-grpc-reproducer
2. Run `./mvnw test`
